questions.question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence:

I think Oka (rind strong-smelling cheese) is a bit too _______ for a cheese plate, as it can overpower the other selections.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pungent**" means having a sharply strong taste or smell. (तीव्र गंध)
 
• Oka cheese being described as strong-smelling indicates that "**pungent**" is the most appropriate word to describe it overpowering other selections.
 
• The other options: "**bland**," "**subtle**," and "**insipid**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I think Oka (rind strong-smelling cheese) is a bit too pungent__ for a cheese plate, as it can overpower the other selections.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bland (नीरस)**: means lacking strong features or characteristics and therefore uninteresting.
 
• **Subtle (सूक्ष्म)**: means delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe.
 
• **Insipid (नीरस)**: means lacking flavor or interest.

Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, / Natasha ran to the nursery,/ but Sonya was not there either.

options.text: Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there,
but Sonya was not there either.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

• The primary issue in the sentence is the missing conjunction **"while"** at the beginning of part 2 to correctly depict the sequence of events.
 
• The sentence should read "Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, **while** Natasha ran to the nursery, but Sonya was not there either." to maintain proper grammatical structure.
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, **while** Natasha ran to the nursery, but Sonya was not there either.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **No error **– This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
